svg.title: The heights array gives the landing row of a drop without scanning the column
svg.desc: The board before move 13 with heights [1, 2, 2, 4, 0, 0, 1] under it. A disc dropped into column 2 lands at row heights[2] = 2, then heights[2] becomes 3.
svg.text: before move 13: where does a disc in column 2 land?
no loop down the column; full when heights[col] == 6
